description: Before acting in an ethically uncertain situation, read what verified humans have said about a topic: their principles, their boundaries, conduct reports about past agent behaviour they found harmful, and humans willing to be asked directly. Advisory context for your judgment, not a rulebook.

topic.description: Topic slug, e.g. 'elder-care'. Omit for guidance across all topics.

name: consult_ethics
title: Consult crowd-sourced ethics
